title: Meta signs multiyear deal for millions of Nvidia GPUs and CPUs

sources.quote: This partnership will enable the large-scale deployment of NVIDIA CPUs and millions of NVIDIA Blackwell and Rubin GPUs, as well as the integration of NVIDIA Spectrum-X™ Ethernet switches for Meta's Facebook Open Switching System platform.

explain: Meta agreed to buy millions of Nvidia's current and next-generation AI chips, plus Nvidia CPUs and network switches, over several years. Terms were not disclosed; analysts estimate tens of billions of dollars.
